newsitem.title: USA: US Vanadium Corp restructures top management.
newsitem.headline: US Vanadium Corp restructures top management.

text.p: U.S. Vanadium Corp, part of Connecticut-based Strategic Minerals Corp, said it has realigned its top management responsibilities.
Vice President Daniel Harris will take over operating responsibility for U.S. Vanadium Corp and will handle production operations, sales, technology and raw material sourcing.

Terry Perles has been named to the new position of General Sales Manager for U.S. Vanadium Corp, responsible for global sales of the company's oxides, chemicals, master alloys, ferro-vanadium and Nitrovan vanadium to steel producers in North America.
Andre Breytenbach will take over as plant manager of Vanadium Corp's Hot Springs operation in Arkansas.
William Curran remains president of U.S. Vanadium.
Strategic Minerals said it is the largest vanadium producer and marketer of vanadium products in the United States.
Vanadium is used by the steel, titanium, chemical, rubber and other industries.
